subject: Application received — Software Engineer at Razorpay
body: Hi Riya, thank you for applying to the Software Engineer role at Razorpay. We have received your application and will be in touch within 2 weeks if your profile matches our requirements.

subject: Interview Invitation — Backend Engineer at Swiggy
body: Hi Riya, we reviewed your profile and would like to invite you to a technical interview for the Backend Engineer position. Please pick a slot: https://calendly.com/swiggy-eng

subject: Exciting Job Opportunity — Work From Home Rs.45,000/month
body: Dear Candidate, Deloitte India is hiring remote data entry executives. Salary: Rs.45,000/month. No experience needed. To confirm your seat, pay a refundable training fee of Rs.2,500 via UPI to secure your onboarding slot. Also send Aadhaar front/back for KYC. Offer expires in 24 hours.

subject: Update on your application — Meesho
body: Hi Riya, after careful consideration we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose profiles more closely match our current requirements. We appreciate your interest in Meesho and encourage you to apply again in the future.

subject: Application Acknowledgement — Product Manager at CRED
body: Thank you for applying to the Product Manager role at CRED. Your application is under review.

subject: Offer Letter — Senior Engineer at PhonePe
body: Dear Riya, we are pleased to extend an offer for the Senior Software Engineer position at PhonePe. CTC: Rs.28 LPA. Please find the formal offer letter attached. Joining date: 1 November 2026.

subject: Work from Home Job — Immediate Joining — No Experience
body: We are Amazon's authorised recruitment partner. We are hiring home-based product reviewers. Earn Rs.800-1200 per hour. Registration fee of Rs.1,500 required. Send your PAN card and bank account number for direct payment setup. Limited seats!

subject: Re: Application — Data Analyst at Zomato
body: Hi Riya, thanks for your patience. We are still in the review process for the Data Analyst role. We will get back to you by end of next week.

subject: Technical Round Scheduled — Freshworks
body: Hi Riya, we would like to schedule a 60-minute technical interview. Our engineer will join you on Google Meet. Please confirm your availability for 22 Oct between 10am-12pm.

subject: Application Status — Ola Electric
body: Thank you for your interest in joining Ola Electric. We have received your application for the role of Systems Engineer. Our team is reviewing profiles and will reach out to shortlisted candidates.

subject: Congratulations — Job Selected — IBM India
body: Dear applicant, you have been selected for IBM India's remote consultant role based on your LinkedIn profile. Salary Rs.60,000/month. To proceed, complete background verification by depositing Rs.3,000 refundable security amount. Reply with your date of birth and Aadhaar number to process your appointment letter.

subject: Your application to Atlassian
body: Hi Riya, thank you for applying to Atlassian via Greenhouse. Your application for Software Engineer (APAC) is under review. You will hear from us within 10 business days.

subject: Not moving forward — Dunzo
body: Hi Riya, we appreciate you taking the time to apply and interview with us. After careful review, we have decided not to move forward with your application at this time. We wish you the best in your search.

subject: Application received — Groww
body: Hi Riya, we have received your application for the Frontend Engineer role at Groww. Our recruiting team will be in touch if there's a match.

subject: URGENT: Government Job Offer — Apply Today
body: Under PM Rozgar Yojana, 200 vacancies are open in your district. Graduates preferred. Monthly Rs.35,000 + benefits. Registration portal fee: Rs.500. Submit Aadhaar, 10th certificate, and 2 passport photos within 48 hours. Offer valid only this week.

subject: Screening call — Razorpay follow up
body: Hi Riya, I'm reaching out from Razorpay's hiring team. We'd like to schedule a 30-minute screening call for the Software Engineer position. Are you available this week?

subject: Your Nykaa application
body: Dear Riya, thank you for your interest in Nykaa. We have received your application for the role of Data Scientist. We will review your profile and be in touch.

subject: Interview — Round 2 — Swiggy
body: Hi Riya, great job on the first round! We would like to invite you for a system design interview. Please book a slot via the link below. The round will be 90 minutes.

subject: Application update — Zepto
body: Thank you for applying to Zepto. After reviewing your profile, we have decided not to proceed with your application at this stage. We hope to connect in the future.

subject: Work from Home — Data Entry — Rs.25000/month — No Experience
body: Tata Group is urgently hiring 500 home-based data entry operators. Salary Rs.25,000/month, paid weekly. No experience required. Training fee Rs.1,200 refundable after 1 month. Send Aadhaar copy and account details to receive your welcome kit and start immediately.
